Keyboard, scrolling, physical-device, update/data-retention, permissions and GPS steps remain a future customer protocol, not claimed as already executed UAT.
Public ERP observation is time-bounded to 2026-11-08T15:58:00.938018Z, reports erpOrigin:null and does not claim a known live deployment SHA or real login.
Old debug-signature mismatch guidance preserves the existing application/data and does not advise destructive reinstall.
Mac guide uses the actual available Simulator bundle and archived signing script/env names. Future Apple export is clearly unexecuted and blocked.
